notes: Units are metres, model centred on its bbox centre (model already faces +z, y up, +x = patient's left, so rotationY is 0). anteriorSurfaceZAt is the front-most surface along the sternal midline (x=0). Ribs counted from the top: rib 1 cartilage meets the manubrium at y~0.077; the manubriosternal joint (slight step) is at y~0.059; rib 2 cartilage meets the sternum just below it (y 0.053), then rib 3 (0.031), rib 4 (0.0115), rib 5 (-0.0065); ribs 6 and 7 follow (-0.0205, -0.034), giving the expected 7 true ribs. Found by ray-casting from +z at x=+-0.016 and reading where cartilage bands start and end. Sternal points use x=+-sternumHalfWidth with z ray-cast on the anterior surface. leftMidclavicularX is half of the rib-5 lateral extent (0.105). The model has no clavicles.
